survey_title: Survey — Visa card pricing in Switzerland

questions.text: How much would you be willing to pay per month as a fixed fee for your Visa card?
Which of the following features would make you more likely to choose one Visa card over another: cashback on grocery purchases, travel insurance, purchase protection, or concierge service?
If Twint offered all the same benefits as your current Visa card, how likely would you be to switch from using your Visa card to Twint for daily transactions?
Would you prefer a Visa card with no monthly fee but higher foreign transaction fees, or a card with a low monthly fee and lower foreign transaction fees?
